committed_before_any_measurement: These rules are in the commit before this F4 run. Every limit is one that was written before an earlier run, and none changes here.
question: Do training, inference and physics of the quadruped task repeat from nothing, all in one run? This is F4 at its target grades: inference A, physics B.
route: cumlx.sim on Genesis (Metal) with MLX inference, the route of docs/ROADMAP-PLATFORM.md. The tasks are in the style of Isaac Lab and are not Isaac Lab, its assets or PhysX

parts.train: go2_flat, genesis, 4096 envs, 300 iterations, seed 1, exit 0: the rule of validation/m6-same-mac-limits.json
parts.commands: With the trained policy in MLX, 128 envs, 1000 steps, seed 7: mean forward speed within 0.2 m/s of +0.8 and -0.8, within 0.1 m/s of 0 for the stop command and for the no-action control, and falls at most 0.1 per world: the rule of validation/m6-same-mac-limits.json
parts.inference: In each of the three evaluations with the policy: the largest absolute difference of the MLX policy from rsl_rl's own actor at most 1e-5, and the same weights with ReLU above it: the absolute rule of validation/m4-sim-limits.json (training.policy_in_mlx.absolute_rule)
parts.physics: go2_flat trajectories of Genesis on Metal against MuJoCo C, seeds 101, 102 and 103, 64 worlds, 50 control steps: median at most 0.1 and p90 at most 0.2 for each seed, and drive stiffness 0.5 times must fail each seed: the rule of validation/m4-sim-limits.json (trajectory.go2_flat). The 4 times smaller MuJoCo time step is reported beside it, as there

grade: inference A and physics B when every part passes
not_a_pass: A part with no output, a stop for memory, disk or time, and a setup error. The run stops at 38 GB of memory in use or at 15 GB of free disk.
